name: Tartaros Academy
card_quote: I'm competitive but not at the highest level. I want to challenge myself and learn the game with active communication with a Tartaros team.
card_desc: This is our second-level team along with Tartaros University and Banana Battalion. With a total of 4 Top 25s and 16 Top 100s, this is the team for you if you want a more forgiving but still competitive and active environment with an active chat, or if you want to prove yourself worthy of the Main Team.
